title: The River That Kept Rising
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who always takes one more step to see what is there, and tonight Ezekiel keeps wading deeper into a river that keeps rising. Scout's wade into the lake, hand in Dad's, is that same curious step.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because a seeker always wants to take one more step and see what happens. In Scout’s world today: Scout waded into the lake in his boots. Ankles, then knees, then he stopped and looked back at Dad, grinning. Dad held out his hand, and they went deeper together. Just like Ezekiel walking deeper into the river, Scout learned that Heavenly Father’s good gifts grow bigger the farther we walk with Him.
